validation.noteRequired: Explain the reason in the note.

validation.expiryRequired: This product requires an expiry date.

errors.creditNoteNumberTaken: This credit note number is already entered for this supplier.

rules.BRANCH_ARCHIVED: The branch is archived. Restore it first.
rules.WAREHOUSE_ARCHIVED: The warehouse is archived. Restore it first.
rules.LAST_OWNER: An organization must keep at least one owner.
rules.OWNER_ROLE_IMMUTABLE: The Owner role always has every permission and cannot be changed.
rules.ROLE_ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_ONLY: This role can only be granted organization-wide.
rules.CANNOT_REMOVE_SELF: You cannot remove yourself from the organization.
rules.INVITATION_NOT_PENDING: This invitation has already been used, revoked or has expired.
rules.INCOMPATIBLE_UNITS: This unit cannot be converted to the product's base unit. Add a product-specific conversion first.
rules.LOT_EXPIRED: This lot has expired and cannot be used. Write it off or quarantine it.
rules.LOT_ON_RECALL_HOLD: This lot is on recall hold.
rules.LOT_EXPIRY_MISMATCH: This lot already exists with a different expiry date.
rules.PRODUCT_NOT_LOT_TRACKED: This product is not lot-tracked: leave lot and expiry empty.
rules.PRODUCT_HAS_HISTORY: Base unit and lot tracking cannot change after stock movements.
rules.PRODUCT_HAS_STOCK: Products with stock on hand cannot be archived.
rules.WAREHOUSE_HAS_STOCK: A warehouse holding stock cannot be archived.
rules.LOCATION_HAS_STOCK: A location holding stock cannot be archived.
rules.OPENING_BALANCE_AFTER_MOVEMENTS: Opening balances are only accepted before other movements of the product in this warehouse. Use an adjustment.
rules.TRANSFER_SAME_PLACE: Source and destination are the same.
rules.STATUS_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: This status change is not allowed.
rules.COUNT_STATUS: This count can no longer be changed in its current status.
rules.COUNT_INCOMPLETE: Every line must be counted first (enter 0 when there is none).
rules.CONVERSION_TO_SELF: The base unit needs no conversion.
rules.ZERO_QUANTITY: The quantity must not be zero.
rules.CANNOT_REVERSE_REVALUATION: A revaluation cannot be reversed. Post a new revaluation instead.
rules.SUPPLIER_HAS_OPEN_ORDERS: This supplier has open purchase orders. Close or cancel them first.
rules.ORDER_STATUS: This is not possible in the order's current status.
rules.ORDER_HAS_NO_LINES: Add at least one line before submitting.
rules.SELF_APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED: You created or submitted this order, so someone else must approve it.
rules.ORDER_NOT_RECEIVABLE: Only approved orders can be received.
rules.OVER_RECEIPT: More than ordered. At most {maximum} more can be accepted on this line.
rules.TEMPERATURE_REQUIRED: Record the temperature of chilled or frozen goods.
rules.NOTHING_RECEIVED: Enter the quantity received for at least one line.
rules.LOT_EXPIRED_ON_RECEIPT: These goods expired on {expiresOn} and cannot be accepted. Reject them instead.
rules.RECEIPT_REVERSE_IN_PURCHASING: Goods receipts are reversed from the receipt page in Purchasing.
rules.RECEIPT_ORDER_CLOSED: The order is closed. Correct the stock with an adjustment instead.
rules.CATEGORY_ARCHIVED: The category is archived. Restore it or choose another.
rules.REORDER_MAX_BELOW_MIN: The maximum must not be below the minimum.
rules.SHIPMENT_STATUS: This is not possible in the shipment's current status.
rules.SHIPMENT_HAS_NO_LINES: Add at least one line before dispatching.
rules.SHIPMENT_LINE_MISSING: Every shipment line must be received.
rules.SHIPMENT_OVER_RECEIPT: You cannot receive more than was dispatched.
rules.SHORTAGE_REASON_REQUIRED: Choose a reason for the shortage.
rules.SHIPMENT_DOCUMENT_NOT_REVERSIBLE: Shipment documents cannot be reversed; cancel or receive the shipment instead.
rules.LANDED_COST_NO_BASIS: There is nothing to spread this cost over with this method. Receipts without stock cannot take landed costs; goods received at no price need allocation by quantity.
rules.LANDED_COST_MIXED_UNITS: The lines are in different units, so the cost cannot be spread by quantity. Spread it by value.
rules.RECEIPT_HAS_LANDED_COST: This receipt has landed costs, so it cannot be reversed. Correct the stock with an adjustment instead.
rules.CANNOT_REVERSE_LANDED_COST: A landed cost cannot be reversed. Correct the cost with a revaluation.
rules.REQUISITION_STATUS: This is not possible in the requisition's current status.
rules.REQUISITION_HAS_NO_LINES: Add at least one line before submitting.
rules.REQUISITION_LINE_ORDERED: This line is already on a purchase order.
rules.RECIPE_VERSION_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft version can be changed. Start a new version.
rules.DISH_NEEDS_PORTIONS: A dish needs the number of portions.
rules.YIELD_UNIT_NOT_FIXED: Use a unit of fixed size (kg, l, each…) for the yield.
rules.RECIPE_IN_USE: Other recipes use this one. Remove it from them first.
rules.SUB_RECIPE_NOT_USABLE: Only preparations that are not archived can be used as sub-recipes.
rules.RECIPE_CYCLE: A recipe cannot contain itself, directly or through other recipes.
rules.RECIPE_HAS_NO_INGREDIENTS: Add at least one ingredient before activating.
rules.RECIPE_HAS_DRAFT: Finish or discard the current draft first.
rules.RECIPE_NEEDS_VERSION: The first version cannot be discarded; archive the recipe instead.
rules.REPLACE_SAME_PRODUCT: Choose a different product to replace it with.
rules.RECALL_STATUS: This is not possible in the recall's current status.
rules.RECALL_HAS_NO_LOTS: Add at least one lot before activating.
rules.CORRECTIVE_NOTE_REQUIRED: Out of spec or failed: say what was done about it.
rules.OWNER_NOT_MEMBER: Choose an active member of the organization.
rules.ACTION_STATUS: Not possible in the action's current status.
rules.SELF_VERIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED: Someone other than the person who did it must verify the action.
rules.NC_ACTIONS_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify every corrective action before closing.
rules.CONSUMPTION_REVERSE_IN_SALES: Reverse sales consumption from the sales import.
rules.NO_VAT_IN_COUNTRY: There is no VAT in force in this country.
rules.INVALID_VAT_NUMBER: The VAT number does not have the expected format for this country.
rules.DEFAULT_TAX_CODE_REQUIRED: Choose the default sales VAT code.
rules.NON_STANDARD_RATE_MUST_BE_ZERO: Zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope codes have a 0 % rate.
rules.INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft invoices can be changed.
rules.DUE_BEFORE_INVOICE: The due date is before the invoice date.
rules.INVOICE_DATE_LOCKED: Remove the lines before changing the invoice date; VAT rates depend on it.
rules.RECEIPT_OTHER_SUPPLIER: This receipt is from another supplier.
rules.RECEIPT_LINE_NOT_ACCEPTED: Nothing was accepted on this receipt line.
rules.INVOICE_NO_EXCEPTION: The invoice matches; there is nothing to approve.
rules.INVOICE_SELF_APPROVAL: You entered this invoice, so someone else must approve its differences.
rules.INVOICE_HAS_NO_LINES: Add at least one line first.
rules.INVOICE_EXCEPTION_NOT_APPROVED: The invoice does not match. Another person must approve the differences first.
rules.NO_TAX_RATE: VAT code {code} has no rate on the invoice date.
rules.UNKNOWN_TAX_CODE: Choose a VAT code that exists.
rules.AMOUNT_TOO_PRECISE: Use at most {decimals} decimals for this currency.
rules.INVOICE_NOT_OPEN: Choose a posted invoice of this supplier.
rules.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_SETTLEMENT: The amounts applied exceed what is available ({available}).
rules.SETTLEMENT_VOIDED: This payment or credit note was voided.
rules.SETTLEMENT_FULLY_APPLIED: This payment or credit note is fully applied.
rules.NOTHING_TO_ALLOCATE: Enter an amount for at least one invoice, or apply to the earliest due first.
rules.INVOICE_HAS_SETTLEMENTS: Payments or credit notes are applied to this invoice; void them first.
rules.ACCOUNTS_NOT_SET: Set the account codes in purchasing settings before exporting a journal.
rules.NO_NUTRITION_PROFILE: No nutrition values are recorded for this product.
rules.NUTRITION_SELF_VERIFY: You entered these values, so someone else must verify them.
rules.NOTHING_DECLARED: Choose a statement for at least one allergen.
rules.FREE_FROM_NEEDS_REFERENCE: A “free from” statement needs the specification or report it comes from.
rules.FREE_FROM_NOT_FROM_DATABASE: A food database cannot show that an allergen is absent; use the specification or a lab report.
rules.NOTHING_TO_VERIFY: No statements by someone else are waiting for verification.
rules.LABEL_PENDING: A label is already waiting for review.
rules.LABEL_DATA_INCOMPLETE: Nutrition or allergen data is missing; see what the label needs.
rules.LABEL_SELF_REVIEW: You generated this label, so someone else must review it.
rules.LABEL_STALE: The data changed since the label was generated; reject it and generate a new one.

organizations.none: You are not a member of any organization yet. Create one, or ask an administrator for an invitation.

overview.title: Overview
overview.stepWarehouse: Add a warehouse to a branch
overview.modulesNote: Inventory, procurement and food-safety modules arrive in upcoming releases.

branches.title: Branches
branches.emptyHint: Branches are your restaurants, kitchens and sites.
branches.name: Name
branches.timeZoneHint: Leave empty to use the organization time zone.
branches.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. EG, SA, AE.
branches.archiveHint: Archived branches are hidden from lists but keep their history.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.emptyHint: Warehouses hold stock. Each belongs to a branch.
warehouses.noBranches: Create a branch before adding warehouses.
warehouses.name: Name
warehouses.locationsHint: Optional subdivisions such as shelves, chillers or freezers.

members.title: Members
members.invitationLinkHint: Share this link with {email}. It can be used once and expires in 7 days. No email is sent automatically.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the organization? They will lose access immediately.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.name: Name
roles.assignments: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {# assignment} other {# assignments}}
roles.ownerLocked: The Owner role always holds every permission.
roles.scopeNote: Branch and warehouse permissions can be limited to one site when the role is granted.

permissionLabels.recipes.costs.view: View recipe costs and cost history
permissionLabels.traceability.view: Trace lots across the organization and view recalls
permissionLabels.foodsafety.view: View food safety records, checklists and non-conformances
permissionLabels.foodsafety.record: Record readings and checks, complete checklists, raise non-conformances
permissionLabels.foodsafety.manage: Manage monitoring points, checklists and corrective actions

permissionLabels.payments.manage: Record supplier payments and credit notes

invite.title: Join {organization}
invite.body: You have been invited to join as {role}.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {current}. Sign out and sign in as {email} to accept.
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

catalog.emptyProductsHint: Add products one by one or import them from a CSV file.
catalog.baseUnitHint: All stock is recorded in this unit.
catalog.lockedAfterHistory: Locked: this product has stock movements.
catalog.conversionsHint: For pack units (case, bag) or units of another dimension. Same-dimension units (g ↔ kg) convert automatically.
catalog.unitsHint: System units are available to everyone. Add your own pack units (e.g. case, tray) and set their size per product.
catalog.categoriesHint: Group products for lists, reports and reorder planning.
catalog.categoryArchiveHint: Archived categories cannot be assigned to products; products keep them until changed.

import.title: Import
import.productsHint: Columns: sku, name_en, name_ar, type, base_unit, lot_tracking, shelf_life_days, storage. Existing SKUs are not changed.
import.openingHint: Columns: warehouse_code, location_code, sku, lot_code, expires_on (YYYY-MM-DD), quantity, unit, unit_cost. One opening-balance document is posted per warehouse.
import.fileRequired: Choose a CSV file to upload.
import.rejected: Nothing was imported: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Fix the file and upload it again.
import.done: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} imported.
import.allOrNothing: Files are validated completely first; nothing is imported unless every row is valid.

inventory.emptyStockHint: Record opening balances to start, or import them from a file.
inventory.reverseHint: Posts the exact opposite of this document. Posted documents are never edited or deleted.
inventory.unitCostHint: Per entered unit, in {currency}. Without a cost the stock is marked “cost missing” until it is revalued.
inventory.newOpeningHint: Initial stock before other movements of a product in a warehouse.
inventory.lotHint: Required for lot-tracked products. New lot codes create a new lot.
inventory.fefoWarning: FEFO: lot {lot} expires earlier ({date}) — pick it first.
inventory.expiredWarning: This lot has expired. It can only be written off or quarantined.
inventory.countHint: The count sheet lists all available stock in scope. The system quantity is captured when each line is counted.
inventory.countEmpty: Nothing on the count sheet. Add items found.
inventory.confirmPost: Post this document? Posted stock movements cannot be edited.
inventory.confirmPostCount: Approve this count and post all differences?
inventory.noAccessToPost: You can view this stock but not move it.
inventory.valuationHint: Moving weighted average cost per product and warehouse, in {currency}.
inventory.costMissingCount: {count, plural, one {# item has} other {# items have}} stock without a known cost
inventory.costMissingHint: Some of this stock was added without a cost. Its value is understated until it is revalued.
inventory.revalueHint: Sets a new average cost for all {product} in {warehouse}. The value of the stock on hand becomes quantity × new cost.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.emptyHint: Add the suppliers you buy from, then the products each one sells.
suppliers.lastPriceHint: Per purchase unit, in {currency}. Updated by each receipt.
suppliers.archiveHint: Archived suppliers cannot receive new orders. Their history is kept.
suppliers.priceVarianceHint: Charged minus ordered price × accepted quantity.
suppliers.noPriceHistory: No receipts from this supplier yet.

purchasing.newOrderHint: Create the order, then add its lines.
purchasing.submitHint: Orders above the approval limit wait for another user's approval; others are approved at once.
purchasing.selfApproval: You created or submitted this order, so someone else must approve it.
purchasing.closeHint: Use when the rest will not be delivered.
purchasing.cancelHint: Only possible while nothing has been received.
purchasing.receiveHint: Enter what arrived. Rejected goods are recorded with a reason and never enter stock.
purchasing.nothingOpen: Nothing is left to receive on this order.
purchasing.reverseReceiptHint: Takes the received stock back out and reopens the order quantities. Not possible once the stock has been used.
purchasing.approvalThresholdHint: Orders above this total, in {currency}, need approval by someone other than their author. Leave empty for no approval step.
purchasing.toleranceHint: How much more than ordered may be accepted on a line. 0 = never more than ordered.

reorder.title: Reorder
reorder.hint: Reorder levels per warehouse. When usable stock plus open orders reaches the minimum, an order up to the maximum is suggested.
reorder.noRules: No reorder levels for this warehouse yet.
reorder.noRulesHint: Add a minimum and maximum for the products you keep in stock here.
reorder.addRule: Add or update a reorder level
reorder.createOrdersHint: One draft order per supplier for the ticked lines, at the supplier's last price. Review and submit them as usual.
reorder.ordersCreated: {count, plural, =0 {No orders created.} one {Created draft order:} other {Created # draft orders:}} {numbers}
reorder.skipped: Skipped (no supplier or no known price): {skus}.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.newHint: Stock leaves the source warehouse when you dispatch and arrives at the destination when it is received.
shipments.dispatchHint: Dispatching moves these quantities to In transit at the source warehouse.
shipments.receiveHint: Enter what actually arrived. Anything less than dispatched is written off with the reason you choose.
shipments.cancelHint: A draft is simply cancelled. A shipment in transit returns its stock to Available at the source.
shipments.noStock: No usable stock in this warehouse.
shipments.noSources: You cannot dispatch from any warehouse.

landedCost.title: Landed costs
landedCost.hint: Freight, duty and other charges are spread over the received lines and added to the cost of the stock still on hand. The share for stock already used is shown as expensed.

requisitions.title: Requisitions
requisitions.hint: Branches ask for the goods they need; buyers turn the requests into purchase orders.
requisitions.submitHint: Once submitted, the lines can no longer be changed.
requisitions.orderHint: Choose a supplier, then the lines to order and their prices. A draft purchase order is created; you can still edit it before submitting.
requisitions.lastPrice: Supplier's last price in this unit.
requisitions.noPrice: No known price in this unit — enter the agreed price.
requisitions.closeHint: The lines not yet ordered will not be ordered.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.hint: Dishes and preparations with versions, yields, waste and costs from real stock and purchase prices.
recipes.newHint: Version 1 is created as a draft; add ingredients, then activate it.
recipes.name: Name (English)
recipes.yieldHint: What one batch makes, after cooking.
recipes.portionsHint: How many portions one batch serves. Required for dishes.
recipes.wasteHint: Trim or preparation loss; the gross amount is net ÷ (1 − waste).
recipes.lockedHint: This version is locked. To change the recipe, start a new version.
recipes.activateHint: Activating makes this the version in use, retires the previous one and stores its cost.
recipes.confirmActivate: Activate this version? It can no longer be changed afterwards.
recipes.policyHint: The chosen source is tried first, then the others. Each line shows the source actually used; lines without any cost are flagged and left out of the totals.
recipes.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# ingredient has} other {# ingredients have}} no cost; the totals leave them out.
recipes.snapshotHint: Stored exactly as calculated at the time; later price changes do not alter it.
recipes.standardCostHint: A cost you set for recipe costing, used from its date onwards. History is kept.
recipes.activateNow: Activate the new versions now (otherwise they stay as drafts to review)
recipes.foodCostHint: Every active dish: cost per portion, selling price, food cost %, margin and the price that meets the target. Dishes with missing costs are never compared with the target.
recipes.hasDraftSkip: Has an open draft — will be skipped
recipes.noDishesUse: No active dish uses this product.
recipes.notUsedAnywhere: No active recipe uses this product.
recipes.orgTargetHint: For all dishes unless a dish has its own. Leave empty for no target.
recipes.quantityFactorHint: New quantity = old quantity × factor, in the same unit (1 = same amount).
recipes.recipeTarget: Target food cost % for this dish
recipes.recipeTargetHint: Leave empty to use the organization's target.
recipes.replaceHint: Swap a product for another in the active version of several recipes. Each gets a new version; nothing changes in versions already in use.
recipes.replaced: {count, plural, =0 {No recipe changed.} one {1 recipe changed:} other {# recipes changed:}} {codes}
recipes.simulationNote: What if {product} cost {cost}? Nothing is saved; stock values are not touched.
recipes.simulatorHint: See how a change in one ingredient's cost affects every dish that uses it, also through preparations.

replaceSkipped.HAS_DRAFT: {code} skipped: it has an open draft.
replaceSkipped.NOT_USED: {code} skipped: it does not use the product.
replaceSkipped.INCOMPATIBLE_UNITS: {code} skipped: its unit does not convert for the new product.

trace.title: Traceability
trace.hint: Follow a lot back to its supplier and forward to every place it went, from recorded movements only. Gaps are listed, not hidden.

gaps.ORIGIN_WITHOUT_SUPPLIER: {quantity} entered in {warehouse} without a supplier (opening balance or adjustment).
gaps.UNLOTTED_USAGE: {quantity} of this product was used in {warehouse} without a lot number — it may have been this lot.

trace.consumptionNote: Imported sales consume stock (first-expiring lots first) and show here as consumption. Production is not recorded yet, so stock turned into other products cannot be traced to them.
trace.noReceipts: No goods receipt recorded for this lot.

recalls.title: Recalls
recalls.hint: Find every unit of the affected lots, hold them everywhere at once, and record what was done.
recalls.newHint: A new recall is a draft: add lots and review the impact before going live.
recalls.reasonHint: E.g. the supplier's notice, the hazard and its source.
recalls.simulationBanner: This is a simulation. Activating the recall puts these lots on recall hold and moves their available and quarantined stock to On hold in every warehouse.
recalls.noSupplier: No supplier recorded for these lots.
recalls.addSupplierLots: Add all lots from this supplier
recalls.inTransitNote: Stock in transit will arrive on hold.
recalls.stockAtActivation: Stock when the recall went live
recalls.activateHint: Puts the lots on recall hold and moves their usable stock to On hold, in every warehouse.
recalls.confirmActivate: Activate this recall now? Stock is put on hold in every warehouse.
recalls.closeHint: Disposed writes off the held stock. Released lifts the recall hold; the stock stays on hold until someone releases it after checking.

foodSafety.title: Food safety
foodSafety.hint: Open non-conformances and recent out-of-spec readings, from real records only.
foodSafety.recordsHint: Temperatures against each point's limits, and pass/fail hygiene, cleaning and pest checks. Records cannot be changed.
foodSafety.correctiveHint: Required when out of spec or failed, e.g. what was moved or discarded.
foodSafety.recordedOutOfSpec: Recorded out of spec — non-conformance {number} opened.
foodSafety.checkpointsHint: Fridges, freezers, hot holding and other points with temperature limits, per branch.
foodSafety.name: Name
foodSafety.checklistsHint: Opening, closing and cleaning checklists. Completed checklists keep their answers exactly as given.
foodSafety.ncHint: Problems found, their cause and corrective actions — done by one person, verified by another.
foodSafety.verifyByOther: Another person must verify this action.
foodSafety.closeBlocked: It can be closed once every corrective action is verified.

sales.title: Sales
sales.hint: Upload sales from your till or POS as CSV. Each sold item uses up stock through its active recipe, first-expiring lots first.
sales.noLiveIntegration: File import only: there is no live connection to a POS yet. Lines already imported (same external id) are skipped, so a file can safely be uploaded again.
sales.uploadHint: Columns: date (YYYY-MM-DD), external_id (unique per sold line), item_code (recipe code or product SKU), item_type (RECIPE or PRODUCT, optional), quantity (portions for dishes, yield unit for preparations, base unit for products), and optionally net_amount (excl. VAT) or gross_amount (incl. VAT), tax_code and channel. When the organization is VAT registered, VAT is worked out per line at the rate in force on the sale date. Nothing is posted unless every row and the stock are fine.
sales.imported: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new to import} one {1 line imported} other {# lines imported}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} other {; # already imported.}}
sales.reverseHint: Puts the stock back and frees these lines to be imported again (e.g. after correcting the file).

errors.unknownItem: No recipe or product with code {code}.
errors.ambiguousItem: {code} is both a recipe and a product; set item_type.
errors.duplicateInFile: This external id appears twice in the file.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough {sku} in stock: {required} needed, {available} usable (expired and recalled lots excluded).

explode.NO_ACTIVE_VERSION: A preparation used by {code} has no active version.
explode.INCOMPATIBLE_UNITS: An ingredient of {code} is in a unit that does not convert.

errors.netOrGross: Give net_amount or gross_amount, not both.
errors.noTaxCode: No VAT code applies; set a default sales code.
errors.noTaxRate: VAT code {code} has no rate on this date.

tax.title: VAT
tax.hint: Country, VAT registration, whether selling prices include VAT, and the VAT codes with their rates over time.
tax.disclaimer: Presets reflect the standard rates checked on 2 November 2026 with their sources. Tax law changes: confirm with your tax adviser and add new rates with their start date when the law changes. Zero-rated, exempt and special cases must be assigned by you; nothing is decided automatically.
tax.presetHint: Creates the codes STD (standard rate with its history), ZERO, EXEMPT and OOS for the country. Running it again only adds missing rates.
tax.presetNoVat: There is no VAT in force in this country; no VAT codes were created.
tax.vatNumberHint: Format check only: Saudi Arabia 15 digits starting and ending with 3; UAE and Bahrain 15 digits; Egypt 9 digits. Only the tax authority can confirm the number is registered.
tax.pricesIncludeTax: Selling prices are entered including VAT
tax.noCodes: No VAT codes yet — apply a country preset or add a code.
tax.name: Name (English)
tax.noRateForPrice: No VAT rate for today — net price unknown
tax.summaryHint: Output VAT from imported sales and input VAT from posted supplier invoices, by code and rate, for a period.
tax.summaryNote: An estimate for review from the sales and invoices recorded here; it does not replace your VAT return.
tax.inputNotReclaimable: The organization is not VAT registered, so this VAT is part of the cost and is not reclaimable.
tax.noInvoices: No posted supplier invoices in this period.

invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.hint: Invoices matched against what was ordered and received (3-way match), with input VAT.
invoices.newHint: Enter the invoice header as printed, then add the received goods and charges it covers.
invoices.dueDateHint: Empty = invoice date plus the supplier's payment terms.
invoices.printedGrossHint: Including VAT, in {currency}, exactly as printed.
invoices.receivedToInvoiceHint: Posted receipts from this supplier. Quantity defaults to what is still open and price to what was charged on receiving.
invoices.nothingToInvoice: Nothing received from this supplier is waiting to be invoiced.
invoices.chargesHint: Delivery, packaging or other charges on the invoice that are not received goods.
invoices.totalMismatch: The invoice total {printed} does not equal the lines {computed}.
invoices.exceptionNeedsApproval: The invoice does not match the order or receipt. Someone other than who entered it must approve the differences before posting.
invoices.exceptionApproved: The differences were approved. Any change to the lines needs a new approval.
invoices.approveHint: Confirm the price, quantity or total differences were checked with the supplier.
invoices.postHint: Posting records the invoice and its input VAT. It does not change stock or its value.
invoices.confirmPost: Post this invoice? It can then only be cancelled.
invoices.priceToleranceHint: How far an invoice price may differ from the order price and still match.

payables.title: Supplier balances
payables.hint: What is owed to each supplier: posted invoices less payments and credit notes, with open invoices aged by due date.
payables.none: No posted supplier invoices or payments yet.
payables.agingNote: Aging uses each open invoice's due date (its invoice date when it has none). A negative balance means the supplier owes you; voided documents never count.
payables.exportHint: CSV files of posted invoices, credit notes and payments dated in the period, for your accounting system. Nothing is sent from here.
payables.journalNeedsAccounts: Set your account codes in purchasing settings to export a journal.
payables.statementHint: Invoices, payments and credit notes with running balance.
payables.onAccount: Not yet applied to an invoice
payables.autoAllocate: Apply to the earliest due invoices first (ignores the amounts below)
payables.noAllocations: Not applied to any invoice yet.
payables.voidHint: Voiding reopens the invoices it was applied to. It cannot be undone; record a new document instead.
payables.accountsTitle: Account codes for the journal export
payables.accountsHint: Your own chart of accounts codes. The journal export uses them as entered; nothing is assumed.

nutrition.neverInferred: Nothing here is estimated. An empty value is unknown, and an allergen without a statement is unknown — never “free from”.
nutrition.valuesHint: Enter the values from the supplier specification, lab report or label, per 100 g or 100 ml. Leave a value empty when it is not known. Replacing keeps the old values in the history.
nutrition.referenceHint: Specification, report or record number; required for specifications and lab reports.
nutrition.confirmVerify: Confirm you checked these against the source?
nutrition.allergensHint: Choose a statement only for the allergens you have information on; the others stay as they are. “May contain” is cross-contact. “Free from” needs a reference and counts only after a second person verifies it.
nutrition.calculationNote: Calculated from the active version and its sub-recipes, using quantities as eaten (without trim waste). A value is shown only when every ingredient has it.
nutrition.noConversion: These ingredients need a weight (or volume) conversion to count:
nutrition.noActiveVersion: This recipe has no active version.
nutrition.labelBlocked: A label can be generated once:

blockers.INCOMPLETE_RECIPE: every sub-recipe has an active version (part of the recipe could not be expanded)
blockers.ALLERGEN_UNKNOWN: {allergen} has a statement for every ingredient (verified if “free from”)
blockers.UNVERIFIED_PROFILES: every ingredient's nutrition values are verified
blockers.NO_PORTIONS_OR_WEIGHT: the recipe has portions or yields a weight or volume
blockers.NO_WEIGHT_FOR_INGREDIENT_LIST: every ingredient has a weight, to order the ingredient list

nutrition.labelStale: The ingredients or their data changed since this label was calculated. Generate a new label.
nutrition.labelNotApproved: Not approved: this label cannot be printed or used.
nutrition.noDeclaredAllergens: None of the 14 listed allergens declared.
nutrition.labelDisclaimer: Calculated from ingredient data recorded in Food Ambassador. Check the labelling rules of the market where it is used.
nutrition.reviewHint: Check the values, allergens and ingredient list against the sources before approving.
nutrition.staleReviewHint: The data changed since this label was calculated; it can only be rejected.
nutrition.matrixHint: Every active recipe against the 14 allergens.
nutrition.matrixNote: “?” means not every ingredient has a statement (or a “free from” is not verified yet). Treat it as a possible allergen.
